text:
sofie: heads-up — final RN draft is ready. dropping the internal blurb in a sec, want ops and PM to confirm rollback lanes.

mike: thanks. can you paste the short internal blurb here so I can sanity-check the wording? cc @anita for rollback criteria.

sofie: sure — 
"Internal: Today we’ll rollout v3.8.1 with improved batch scheduling and a smaller memory regression fix. Expected user impact: none. Ops will monitor alpha region for 30m then ramp. If latency spike > 2x baseline or error rate > 1% sustained for 10m, we will rollback to v3.8.0."

anita: wording looks fine. a few notes on the rollback thresholds: 1% error sustained 10m is ok, but for tail-latency we should use p99 rather than mean. suggest: p99 > 2.5x baseline for 5m OR error rate > 1% for 10m.

mike: agree with p99 change. also add a data-loss/backfill note: if we detect inference output regressions on the canary eval set (precision drop > 3%), trigger immediate pause not full rollback; route traffic to fallback model.

sofie: updated blurb: 
"Internal: Rolling out v3.8.1 (batching + memory fix). Ops will monitor alpha for 30m then ramp. Abort conditions: p99 latency > 2.5x baseline for 5m OR error rate > 1% for 10m. If inference quality on canary eval drops precision > 3% then pause rollout and switch traffic to v3.8.0-fallback variant while we investigate."

elaine: +1. where are we pinning versions? want to call out exact pin IDs for Dedicated customers.

sofie: good call. we will pin dedicated customers to 3.8.0 until we do a manual opt-in. release note will include the pin ID and steps.

zach: deploy-bot status before we start? can we do a dry-run to staging first?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Requested: dry-run deploy v3.8.1 -> staging. ETA ~ 3m. Logs: 
```
deploy: start 4922223333-dryrun
step1: pull image redwood/runtime:v3.8.1
step2: apply config: batching=adaptive, kv_cache=on
status: succeeded
tests: canary-evals passed (precision delta 0.4%)
```

ops-oncall: dry-run looked clean. I'll be on standby for the alpha window. timeline?

sofie: plan - alpha deploy at 14:00 PT, monitor 30m, ramp 25% at 14:30, 50% at 15:00, full by 16:00 if no abort. prep doc shows timezones.

mike: sending internal announce draft to staff channel at T+10 after alpha start. keep it short: TL;DR, expected no end-user change, ops escalation notes, PM contact.

anita: quick checklist for rollbacks: 1) ops triggers deploy-bot rollback command `deploy-bot rollback v3.8.0 --region alpha` 2) product notifies affected teams 3) open incident with severity tag if customer SLA impacted 4) run postmortem template.

sofie: I'll add that to the RN ops section. also adding contact matrix with pager contacts.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] pre-rollout snapshot created: snapshot-2026-03-20-14:00. To rollback: `deploy-bot rollback snapshot-2026-03-20-14:00 --region alpha`.

elaine: for the internal announcement copy, propose a one-paragraph blurb + bullet ops escalation. Draft: 
"Today we will deploy v3.8.1 to alpha at 14:00 PT. No user-facing changes expected. Ops will monitor metrics; rollback criteria and rollback command are documented in the RN. PM contact: @elaine, Eng lead: @sofie."

sofie: love it. final ask: anyone opposed to including a short note about Dedicated pinning (we hold on 3.8.0 by default)?

mike: include it. also include link to rollout dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/rollouts/3.8.1

anita: one more ops nit — add a recovery runbook pointer in the RN: /docs/runbooks/model-fallback.md

sofie: done. I'm going to post RN and the internal announce at 13:50 PT. we will call this thread the coordination lane for the alpha window. ping here if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:
